# Vendored rumahl UI source

This directory is a snapshot of `@rumahl/ui` from the rumahl repository
(`frontend/packages/ui/src`). The website needs it to render the native RUI
component explorer at `/design/rui/components` without a sibling checkout.

- Source: `rumahl/rumahl`, Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)
- Refresh: `scripts/sync-rumahl-ui.sh` (set `RUMAHL_REPO` if needed)
- Do not edit it by hand. Changes belong in the rumahl repository.
- Tests are omitted; they need the RUI development dependencies.
